friendly_name: Charter offering, activation presets and the doctrine-to-charter cutover
purpose_context: Earlier renames kept old names working, leaving two names for one thing: agents and contributors get confused and users' harnesses contradict themselves. Following ADR 2026-10-06-1, a Charter Pack becomes a bundle of charter components plus activation presets applied with charter activate --pack/--preset, the doctrine command group and skill names are cut over in one step, and one upgrade migration rewrites existing projects so nothing silently loses activated artifacts.
purpose_tldr: Replace the retired doctrine-pack vocabulary with one charter vocabulary across CLI, config, skills, code and docs, with activation presets as pack data and no compatibility layer.
